findings.claim: 10-K FY2026 稱 FTC 與 HHS 2024 年就批發商／GPO 對學名藥短缺影響徵求公開意見，之後無進一步行動；並稱醫療業反壟斷執法仍是 FTC/DOJ 重點，策略交易可能需競爭主管機關審查。
findings.excerpt: the Federal Trade Commission (“FTC”) and HHS issued a request for public comment in 2024 on how the practices of pharmaceutical wholesalers and group purchasing organizations impact generic drug shortages. Various industry stakeholders responded to this request, but no further action has been taken by the FTC or HHS.

findings.claim: FY2026 10-K Item 3 僅指向附註 17，未在該節單獨列出針對 MCK 的新反壟斷調查；MCK 反而是反壟斷和解金的受益方（FY2026 $23M、FY2025 $444M）。
findings.excerpt: Gross profit for the years ended March 31, 2026 and 2025 included gains of $23 million and $444 million, respectively, representing our share of antitrust legal settlements.

note: 搜尋未見 2026 年 DOJ/FTC/EU 針對 MCK 的新案；2024 年倡議團體曾要求 FTC 阻擋腫瘤收購，無 FTC 決定可查。
